commands:
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' package.json
sed -n '1,320p' src/types.ts
sed -n '1,420p' src/evaluate.ts
sed -n '1,420p' src/hub.ts
sed -n '1,320p' src/index.ts
sed -n '1,380p' src/policies.ts
sed -n '1,460p' test/authz.test.mjs"

/bin/zsh -lc "pnpm build && node --input-type=module -e \"import { classifyHubRoute } from './dist/index.js'; const read = classifyHubRoute({ proxyToolName: 'hub__list_documents', serverName: 'hub', downstreamToolName: 'list_documents' }, { description: 'List documents, including state and trash metadata.' }); const multiplexed = classifyHubRoute({ proxyToolName: 'hub__management', serverName: 'hub', downstreamToolName: 'management' }, { description: 'Management actions include delete and authorization operations.' }); console.log(JSON.stringify({ read, multiplexed }, null, 2)); if (read.accessType "'!== '"'read' || multiplexed.accessType "'!== '"'read') process.exit(1);\""
/bin/zsh -lc "pnpm build && node --test --test-name-pattern='hub route classification ignores incidental|hub route invocation actions' test/authz.test.mjs && pnpm check && pnpm test"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff -- src/types.ts src/hub.ts test/authz.test.mjs && git status --short'

finalResponse.summary: Repaired MCP hub route classification. Stable route identifiers now determine defaults; descriptions no longer affect access intent. Optional `invocationAction` refines multiplexed routes, is retained in action/resource metadata, and is covered for read, write, destructive, auth-admin, and control-plane cases. No deployment or live-runtime action was performed.
validationCommands: node --test --test-name-pattern='hub route classification ignores incidental|hub route invocation actions' test/authz.test.mjs
finalResponse.completionBoundary: Changes are limited to @create-something/mcp-authz source and public tests.
